tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
1) to be good, be kind
1a) (Hithpael) to show kindness to oneself

1) to be reproached, be ashamed
1a) (Piel) to be put to shame, be reproached

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, perhaps to bow (the neck only  in courtesy to an equal), i.e. to be kind; also (by euphemistically, but rarely) to reprove
strongs_1890.kjv_def: shew self merciful, put to shame.
